description.value: Reef Point Cottages is a collection of self-contained cottage rentals scattered across the rainforest-meets-ocean landscape of Ucluelet on Vancouver Island's wild west coast, with unit sizes ranging from studios to a three-bedroom cottage. Several units feature private hot tubs and forest or waterfront views, and the property is pet-friendly. It sits minutes from the Wild Pacific Trail and Pacific Rim National Park, making it a practical base for touring cyclists exploring this stretch of the coast.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms Reef Point Cottages is an active self-catering cottage rental property in Ucluelet with multiple unit types. The About page confirms the address as 1012 Peninsula Road, Ucluelet, BC V0R 3A0, matching OSM; the local phone +1 250 726 4425 matches OSM's +1-250-726-4425 (a toll-free 1-877-726-4425 is also listed). No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, Wi-Fi, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content, so all such fields are null.
concerns: Individual cottage units are registered at separate street addresses on Tyee Terrace and Boardwalk Boulevard; 1012 Peninsula Road appears to be the office/booking address rather than the location of all cottages.
FAQ page contains BC CDC pandemic-era guidelines, suggesting some content has not been updated, though core booking information appears current.
OSM tags the property as tourism=hotel but it operates as self-catering cottage rentals — minor tag inaccuracy, not grounds for exclusion.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational accommodation in a cycling-relevant location; booking functionality is active and the website is current.
enrichment_extras.notes: A toll-free number 1-877-726-4425 is prominently displayed on the website in addition to the local number matching OSM.
